title: Add sarcastic banter option to zero-LLM background soak conversations
goal: Let zero-LLM background soak NPCs deliver sarcastic banter through the same speech-tone contract as LLM and human characters.

sections.what: Add a sarcastic conversation/banter option to engine/background_social.py so background soak NPCs can express sarcasm without calling an LLM.
sections.why: Soak NPCs do not use LLMs for dialogue, so adding sarcastic banter directly onto engine/background_social.py ACTIONS (lines 135-197) keeps background social tone aligned with task-994's speech-tone contract at zero LLM cost.
sections.how:
1. Add a sarcastic banter option (or tone metadata on tease/joke hostile_variant) in engine/background_social.py ACTIONS (lines 135-197) and BASE_WEIGHTS (lines 208-210).
2. Route soak banter tone through engine/speech_tone.py perceive_speech_tone so listeners react subjectively by closeness, mood, and Insight without any LLM call.
3. Add deterministic unit tests in tests/test_background_social.py.

acceptance.text: engine/background_social.py ACTIONS supports sarcastic banter (or tone-tagged tease/joke delivery) so soak NPCs can deliver sarcastic remarks without an LLM.
Sarcastic soak interactions pass speech_tone='sarcastic' through engine/speech_tone.py subjective perception and apply appropriate affect/relationship deltas.
Unit tests in tests/test_background_social.py verify sarcastic soak banter shifts affect/relationships differently from warm teasing.

custom.browser_ui: No new UI controls required. Verify in the Event Stream / Mind Inspector that background soak NPCs occasionally emit sarcastic banter and that listeners react appropriately without LLM calls.
